claims.title: Carrier-sensitive glide requires same-network reaction selection and a calibrated retained endpoint

status: Source claims plus separate internal advances; externally unreviewed.
interface: Actual material-specific carrier/core, stress/pinning, thermal/noise, Burgers/slip-plane/topology and irreversible history; one coupled illumination control with legal global comparators. Dimensionless pulse example is a reduced mathematical model, not acquired ZnS coefficients. Target-local structural/fault/boundary/slip and retained functional assays are required. T-center conditional preparation regimes remain separate from useful multi-emitter output.
limits: Acquire a real mapped Burgers/core/slip-compatible target and competitor in one demonstrated platform; randomized optimized-dark,constant,dose-order,heat/readout controls; calibrated topology/fault/boundary/slip and retained functional endpoint with complete input per target. Stop at mobility if no same-network causal selection map is obtained. For T-centers measure raw pair interference/yield and full herald/storage costs in one regime.
